name: Output-equivalent token-counter fast path and stable-prefix lower bound
source_constraint: All src/ Git blobs at the tooling base equal the frozen baseline. Only src/memory_book/token_budget.py may differ in this experiment; candidate Git/source hashes are recorded at execution.

changes.proof: tiktoken 0.12.0 documents equivalence to encode(text, disallowed_special=()); both use the same surrogate repair. This removes special-token scanning without changing literal evidence treatment.

changes.operation: Expose the existing stable-prefix count as a conservative minimum and stop an impossible page after existing lazy preparation
changes.proof: The current prepared count is stable_count + count(tail + candidate), whose second term is nonnegative. If stable_count > budget_tokens, every remaining candidate on that page would be rejected. Unicode-tail or byte-prefix fallback supplies minimum_tokens=0.
changes.preserve: First candidate uses a full exact count. Prefix preparation remains index == 1 and len(choices) > 3. Only strict > rejects; equality must continue.

unchanged: all payload fields except already excluded latency_ms
previous frozen performance and quality reports

validation.script_changes: None; use its existing complete-payload equivalence and sequential worker timing.
validation.gate: Every complete result payload hash must match the frozen baseline after excluding only latency_ms; repeated payloads must remain identical; sources/evaluator must remain unchanged.
focused_tests: ordinary counts equal the previous public tokenizer entry point, including literal specials and malformed surrogates
stable minimum never exceeds exact full counts across Unicode/boundary joins
partial UTF-8 and non-prefix stable-byte fallbacks expose zero and preserve full count
first-choice success and short-list full counting stay lazy
over-budget stable minimum skips only impossible candidates; equality does not prune
96-candidate bound and accepted legacy entries remain unchanged

execution.runtime: Independent GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 VM, Python 3.12, tiktoken 0.12.0.
execution.method: Frozen baseline then candidate in sequential isolated worker processes on one host; each initializes tokenizers before timed queries; no result cache; original deterministic query shuffle; 3 repetitions.
execution.durability: Commit registration, implementation/tests and workflow in separate stages. Always publish available reports and explicit failed/success status to a run-specific validation branch; never overwrite previous attempts.
execution.no_extra_runs: Do not rerun the completed native quality matrix, external transfer cohort, competitor benchmarks or generated-answer jobs.

interpretation: Report every setting's baseline/candidate p50, p95 and mean, including ties and regressions. Sequential engine order, naturally warm OS/SQLite caches and one host limit timing conclusions. Passing equivalence is not evidence of a speed gain; promotion to main requires review of measured benefit. Do not adjust parameters or select questions based on outcomes.
